properties.value: Decreases the boss' damage from non-Crits by 80% and grants the ally with the highest Crit DMG a 40% ATK bonus.

When dealing damage on own turn, inflicts additional true damage equal to 20% of the damage dealt to the enemy.

Normal attacks also inflicts 40% of splash damage. At the end of turn, reduces all allies' damage received by 5%, max of 30 stacks. When the ally with the highest ATK uses a normal attack, they immediately gain an additional action. At the end of their turn, their move bar is increased by 35%.
Boss' indirect damage received is decreased by 99% and own DEF is decreased by 35%.
When dealing damage, the damage is increased by 4% for each buff, max of 5 stacks. At the end of the turn, increases own move bar by 20%.

Request extraction covers fetch, WebSocket, node:http/node:https construction, direct option fields, and exact local response consumers.
Resource extraction covers built-in filesystem/network acquisition and exact local close/destroy/end handles.
The semantic graph contains static syntax observations and conservative relationship candidates; it does not claim runtime execution.
Timer extraction covers global or node:timers scheduling and exact local-handle cancellation.

JavaScript and HTML were parsed as inert text; bundle bootstrap code was never executed.
